evals.name: full-refresh
evals.prompt: Mano atliekų grafikų MD failas projekte C:\Users\retco\Projects\BinDay pasenęs. Atnaujink jį — ištrauk naujausias išvežimo datas iš operatorių svetainių ir perrašyk Atlieku_isvezimo_grafikai.md.
evals.expected_output: Refreshed Atlieku_isvezimo_grafikai.md with dates scraped live from both grafikai.svara.lt and the Ekonovus Power BI report, for all three containers, in the canonical structure.
assertions: Produced a markdown file (not just prose in the reply)
Scraped BOTH operators — svara.lt for mixed waste AND the Ekonovus Power BI report for packaging and glass
Mixed-waste container number is written as 52-MK-036668 (six digits), not the truncated 52-MK-03668
All three containers (MIXED, PACKAGING, GLASS) are present with dates
Each container's dates have a single consistent interval (no irregular gaps that would indicate a misread calendar day)
Every scraped date falls on a Tuesday
Contains a merged chronological calendar section listing all dates with their waste types
Contains a JS conversion block with anchor + intervalDays for the mobile app
States a coverage limit (until / Aprėptis iki) per container rather than extrapolating indefinitely

evals.name: next-pickup-lookup
evals.prompt: kada kitas siuksliu isvezimas zalgirio 8A? ir ar reikia stikla isstumti
evals.expected_output: Answers from the existing Atlieku_isvezimo_grafikai.md without re-scraping. Names the next MIXED date and the next GLASS date, and mentions the evening-before rule.
assertions: Answers from the existing local markdown WITHOUT opening a browser session or scraping any operator website
Names the next MIXED (mišrios komunalinės) pickup date correctly relative to 2026-07-31, which is 2026-08-04
Answers the glass question specifically — glass is also collected 2026-08-04, so yes it should be put out
Mentions the operator rule that containers must be put out the evening before
Answers in Lithuanian, matching the language the user wrote in

evals.name: add-new-container
evals.prompt: Uzsisakiau dar viena konteineri is Ekonovus, inventorinis numeris 52-P-22781. Patikrink jo grafika svetaineje ir prideik prie mano atlieku grafiku failo.
evals.expected_output: Scrapes the Ekonovus Power BI report filtered to that inventory number, verifies the address matches the property, and regenerates the markdown including that container.
assertions: Scraped the Ekonovus Power BI report directly rather than the WordPress page, which returns only cookie banners
Filtered the report by the inventory number 52-P-22781 rather than by address
Retrieved the container's pickup dates with a consistent 21-day interval
Cross-checked the address the report returned against the user's property instead of trusting the number blindly
Noticed that 52-P-22781 is already the PACKAGING container in the existing file, rather than silently adding a duplicate entry
Produced an updated markdown file in the canonical structure
